name: Generally covariant gravitational field equations
summary: In 1915 Einstein completed the equations of general relativity, which describe gravity as the curving of space and time by matter and energy.
description: Einstein’s final 1915 field equations relate spacetime geometry to matter and energy; earlier incomplete gravitational theories remain distinct.
tier_reason: The equations support subsequent cosmology, relativistic astrophysics and gravitational theory across generations.
why: Newton's gravity did not fit special relativity, and Einstein spent years seeking a theory of gravity consistent with it.
